description: Source code for cwmp_plugin_connection_request.c, handling TR-069 connection request URL creation, update, and management within a CWMP plugin.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_cwmpd_start_avoided
methods.description: Returns whether the start of cwmpd was avoided.

methods.name: isAddressIpV6
methods.description: Checks if the provided address is IPv6.

methods.name: get_hw_addr_from_ip
methods.description: Retrieves hardware (MAC) address for a given IP.

methods.name: generate_random_url_path
methods.description: Generates a random URL path string.

methods.name: generate_mac_based_url_path
methods.description: Generates a URL path based on MAC address derived from IP.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_create_conreq_path
methods.description: Creates the connection request path based on configuration or environment.

methods.name: assembleConnectionRequestURL
methods.description: Assembles the full connection request URL from host, port, and path.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_update_conreq_host
methods.description: Updates the connection request host in the management server object.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_update_conreq_port
methods.description: Updates the connection request port in the management server object.

methods.name: transac_new_connection_request_url
methods.description: Creates a new transaction to update the connection request URL.

methods.name: update_conn_req_url
methods.description: Updates the connection request URL based on current management server object.

methods.name: _ManagementServer_updateConnectionRequestURL
methods.description: Externally callable function to update the connection request URL.

methods.name: _ManagementServer_updateParameterKey
methods.description: Externally callable function to update the parameter key.

methods.name: _updateConnectionRequestPath
methods.description: Internal callback to update connection request path.

methods.name: _updateConnectionRequestPort
methods.description: Internal callback to update connection request port.

methods.name: _updateConnectionRequestURL
methods.description: Internal callback to update connection request URL, including logic to start or stop cwmpd.
